items.title: Spec-Driven Development, Explained for Designers
items.description: A caption field on my portfolio made the idea click: write down the change, give the agent enough context, and check what it builds against what you asked for.

items.title: What I Learned Rebuilding My Portfolio in Claude Code
items.description: I wanted better video on my portfolio. Rebuilding it led to a new CMS, a homemade dictation tool, and a lot of time spent trying to describe animations.

items.title: Focus Is the Tool: Working at an Agent's Pace
items.description: An e-ink phone has helped me concentrate. AI makes that harder in a different way: there are suddenly far more things I can start than I can finish.

items.title: When the Designer Builds: Rethinking the Handoff at a Newsroom
items.description: At El Confidencial, I spend too much time correcting the gap between Figma and production. I want to test a workflow where I build with an agent and a developer reviews the result.
